<ApiTitle method="post" title="Void Document" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/turbosign/documents/{documentId}/void"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Cancels a signature document so it can no longer be signed, and records your reason in the audit trail. A document that is already voided or has expired cannot be voided.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"documentId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The signature document ID.","schema":{"type":"string","format":"uuid"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["reason"],"properties":{"reason":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500,"description":"Why the document is being voided. Recorded in the audit trail.","example":"Terms changed; a new version will be sent."}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"The document was voided.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"data":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","format":"uuid"},"name":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","example":"voided"},"voidReason":{"type":"string"},"voidedAt":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"}}}}},"example":{"data":{"id":"4a20eca5-7944-430c-97d5-fcce4be24296","name":"Service Agreement","status":"voided","voidReason":"Terms changed; a new version will be sent.","voidedAt":"2026-01-17T09:12:00.000Z"}}}}},"400":{"description":"`reason` is missing or too long, or the document cannot be voided (`DocumentVoided`, `DocumentExpired`, `DocumentNotVoidable`).","content":{"application/json":{"examples":{"validation":{"summary":"Missing reason","value":{"message":"There was an issue validating the body","type":"ValidationError","data":{"errors":[{"message":"Void reason is required","path":["reason"],"type":"any.required","context":{"label":"reason","key":"reason"}}]}}},"alreadyVoided":{"summary":"Already voided","value":{"error":"Document has been voided and cannot be voided again","code":"DocumentVoided"}}}}}},"401":{"description":"Missing or invalid API key, or the organization ID header is missing or is not an organization the key belongs to. The response has no body."},"403":{"description":"The key's role cannot void documents (viewers cannot).
